transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in today?

I'm not really sure where to start. I guess... I just stopped caring about things. Stuff I used to look forward to. Like my fishing gear... it's just been sitting out in the garage untouched. The woodshop just feels like a chore now. Even when the kids try to get me to play chess, I'm... I'm just going through the motions.
Have you noticed that you don’t take pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like fishing or working in your woodshop?
Yeah... like I was just saying. I just don't get anything out of it anymore. None of it. Not the shop, not the fishing... it's all just flat. I don't really know why.
Have you been feeling down or depressed most of the day, nearly every day?
I don't know. I haven't really... I don't really think of it as being depressed. Just... I don't know. Blank, maybe. I haven't really been paying attention to it.
How long have you been feeling this way, like you’re just going through the motions without getting anything out of the things you used to enjoy?

A while. Um... probably about a year and seven months, give or take. It was right around when my wife started having some health problems. Everything at home just kind of... changed. I guess that's when it started.
Have you felt this way — like you're just going through the motions and not getting anything out of life — for most of the time over the past two years?
I mean... like I just said. It's been about a year and seven months. Not two years. But... yeah, I guess. Most of that time.
Have you found that you don’t enjoy or have interest in *any* activities — like fishing, chess, or anything else — for at least a couple of weeks at a time?

Yeah... I guess so. It's been longer than a couple weeks, really. I just... I stopped caring about the things I used to look forward to. My fishing gear is just sitting out in the garage, untouched. The woodshop just... feels like a chore now. Even when the kids try to get me to play chess, I'm... I'm really just going through the motions.
Have you felt a lack of energy or noticed that you get tired much more easily than before, nearly every day?

Yeah... I do. It's... well, by midmorning I feel like I’ve already worked a full shift. Walking the project site, even just climbing the stairs with the crew... it feels like my body is carrying wet concrete. Just... heavy. Every day.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or weight — like eating less than usual or losing weight without trying?

Yeah... I suppose so. I just haven't been eating much. Most days food just tastes like cardboard anyway. 

I'll usually skip breakfast... and even if I've been out on the site all day, I just end up picking at dinner. I wasn't trying to lose weight, but... yeah, my belt's had to come in a couple notches lately.
Have you completely lost interest in all activities, even the ones you used to really enjoy, for an extended period of time?

Yeah... like I mentioned a minute ago... I just stopped caring about all of it. The fishing gear, the woodshop... it's all just sitting there. Even with the kids, I'm just... going through the motions. It's been like that for a long time now.
Have you felt down or sad most of the day, nearly every day, during this time?
I don't... I wouldn't say sad. I'm not sitting around crying or anything. It's more just... I don't know. I don't really feel much of anything at all. Just kind of... blank, I guess.
Have you felt this way — like you're emotionally blank or down — most of the time, nearly every day, for at least two years?

No, not two years. It's been... I don't know, maybe a year and a half? A little more... a year and seven months, I think. Ever since my wife got sick and things at the house changed. Just... since then.
Have you felt emotionally down or in a depressed mood most of the day, more days than not, over the past two years?
I thought I just... I mean, like I said a second ago, it hasn't been two years. Just that year and a half. And I don't know about being in a depressed mood. Just... what I said before. Blank.
Have you, at any point over the past two years, had a period where you felt down or emotionally blank for most of the day, for several weeks or more?
Yeah. I mean... like I just said, it's been that whole year and a half. It hasn't really stopped. So... yes.
Have you had days where you felt emotionally down or blank nearly every day for as long as two years?

I... I feel like I keep saying the same thing here. No. Not two years. Like I just told you, it's been about a year and seven months. Just... since my wife's health problems changed everything at the house.
So, just to be clear, have you had a period where you felt emotionally down or blank nearly every day for a duration of two years or more?
No. I... I really don't know how else to say it. It hasn't been two years.
Have you had symptoms like feeling emotionally blank, losing interest in activities, and low energy for at least two full years without a break lasting more than a couple of months?
No. Like I said... it hasn't been two years. Just a year and a half.
Have you had symptoms like feeling emotionally blank, losing interest in activities, or having low energy for a total of at least two years, even if they improved for a few months at a time?
...No. I... I really don't have a different answer for you. It hasn't been two years. Just the year and a half.

Have your symptoms, like feeling emotionally blank, losing interest in activities, and having low energy, been present for at least two years when considering any periods of improvement that might have been shorter than a few months?

...Look, I really don't know how many times I can say no. It hasn't been two years. It's been... about a year and seven months. That's when my wife's health problems started, and... well, everything changed at home. But no. Not two years.

Have you experienced a loss of interest in activities you used to enjoy for a total of at least two years, even if there were short periods where you felt a little better but not fully back to normal?

I... I don't really understand why you keep asking me the exact same thing. 

No. Like I just told you... it hasn't been two years.
